messages:
anya (Design): quick one — i pushed a variant of the rollout timeline that tries to be keyboard-first and colour-safe. sketch: https://img.redwood.local/rollout-legend-v3.png :eyes:
anya (Design): main idea = color + micro-pattern (stripes/dots) for canary/risky vs stable, plus an accessible label for each segment that reads traffic% + health (e.g. 'v2.3: 10% traffic, error rate 0.4%'). thoughts?
michael (PM): i like the keyboard-first callout. can we keep the legend minimal? product people prefer short labels — "canary / stable / rollback" — and push details into tooltip.
sam (Eng): patterns are fine but rendering tiny dot patterns on WebGL canvas may be noisy. would prefer using a 1px dashed border for canary + solid for stable, and pair with an icon (warning triangle) for risky. also: perf note — avoid SVG filters per-se for many timeline items.
luis (A11y): agree with aria pairing. proposal for screen readers: aria-label on each segment = "Version v2.3, receiving 10 percent traffic, healthy; can press enter for more details." and an aria-live region that announces changes when rollout % crosses thresholds (example copy: "Canary v2.3 increased to 20 percent traffic; error rate 0.9 percent, degraded"). also recommend not relying on color alone and add visible focus rings. :a11y:
jordan (SRE): for health microcopy use timeframe context: "error rate (5m)" or "latency p95 (5m)" — otherwise ops will misinterpret spikes. also +1 for announcing metric thresholds only (avoid too frequent aria-live noise).
anya (Design): good call — i'll change tooltip text to include timeframe and move the health dots into the tooltip too. question on rollback flow copy: current modal says "This will rollback to v2.2 and invalidate canary cache." is "invalidate canary cache" ok or too technical?
michael (PM): too nerdy. suggest: "This will route all traffic back to v2.2 and stop current canary traffic." short + clear.
sam (Eng): behavior: rollback will also warm the older model variant on the dedicated pool — maybe mention "warming" only in advanced docs, not modal.
luis (A11y): modal aria: role=alertdialog, focus trapped, confirm button labeled "Rollback to v2.2" and secondary "Cancel". include concise accessible description: "This action will route all production traffic to v2.2."
deploy-bot: canary v2.3 created — traffic 10% — started at 1893456789
anya (Design): ok action items: 1) i update legend to use border+icon+pattern fallback for small sizes; 2) change modal copy to michael's phrasing; 3) add aria-live phrasing as luis suggested; 4) sam to confirm rendering approach for patterns or borders. will post updated mock by EOD. :thumbsup:
michael (PM): thanks — let's aim to ship legend change behind a feature flag so we can test with customers.
sam (Eng): ack — will prototype CSS fallback and share perf numbers.
luis (A11y): will run keyboard + screen reader pass once mock is up.
anya (Design): thanks everyone!"
